attempts.reasoning: Added cursor pagination to listItems. Mutual exclusivity of page and cursor is checked first. pageSize parsing is shared. In cursor mode, empty string means first page; otherwise decodeCursor is used and any failure or invalid shape (missing/non-finite createdAt/id) becomes ApiError 400 'invalid cursor'. Items are filtered by (createdAt < cursor.createdAt) or (createdAt == cursor.createdAt && id < cursor.id) to respect newest-first ordering and handle non-unique createdAt without skipping/duplicating. nextCursor is null when no items remain (filtered.length <= pageSize), otherwise it's encodeCursor({createdAt, id}) of the last item. Legacy offset path is kept byte-for-byte identical.
